question_text: Compare supervised classification and unsupervised clustering for analysing incident records.
adaptation_rationale: Classification/clustering explicitly scoped. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Classification trains on labelled incidents to assign a new record to a known category; clustering groups records by feature similarity without supplied category labels. Both use incident features, but one predicts predefined classes while the other explores groups that may reveal new patterns.

marking_points.criterion: Groups by similarity without supplied class labels.
Paired contextual comparison explains prediction versus exploratory grouping.
